title: 3.7 Where Are You From?
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Ask Woher kommst du? and answer Ich komme aus Mexiko / aus den USA; say Mexikaner/Mexikanerin, Amerikaner/Amerikanerin.
grammar_function: Woher kommst du? Ich komme aus + country. Ich bin + nationality (-in for a woman).
